messages:
Sasha: Heads-up — planning phased rollout of SDK v3.1 tomorrow 2026-04-02 10:00 PST. Aim: migrate hosted API clients, ensure backward compat for v3.0. Canary for 5% of traffic for 20m, then 25% for 40m, then full if metrics look good. Owner: @Jordan will kick off.

Jordan: I can run the deploy. ETA 10:00 PST. I'll follow smoke checklist below. @Kevin did we add deprecation header for v2 compat?

Kevin: We added `Deprecation: deprecated-until=2026-07-01` header but kept old behavior when `client_version=3.0` param. No breaking changes in generator API. :+1:

Liz: Client comms: I have email + changelog draft. Should mention new features and minor behaviour change in tokenization for embeddings. Suggest a blog post next week.

Sasha: Smoke checklist — run these after canary:
```bash
# health
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v3/health
# sample gen
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}'
# embeddings
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}'
```

Jordan: I'll post results in this thread. If errors > 0.5% or latency p90 increases >20% during canary, rollback.
Rollback command:
```
redwoodctl rollout cancel --deployment sdk-v3-1 --reason "canary-failed"
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment for sdk-v3-1 by @Jordan at 2026-04-02T10:00:00-08:00. Canary policy: 5% x20m -> 25% x40m -> 100% x30m.

Kevin: Also checking client libs — patched versions for node/python are ready; will publish after canary passes.

Liz: I'll hold the email until canary green. Draft: https://docs.google.com/...

Jordan: Starting canary in ~10m. Will ping when it's live.

Sasha: Thanks. If anyone can't make the window ping me and we'll reschedule. :thumbsup:
